self_conditional_modifiers_json.description: R1: when the wielder's Bond of Life amount changes, gain 1 stack: all DMG +16% per stack for 6s, max 3 stacks. Quoted values are R1; this entry also declares its R5 values in refinementStates, and the leaderboard's chosen weapon refinement selects between them (R2-R4 read R1).

en.flavor: A rapier once wielded by a deceiver who had forsaken everything. In the past, it was primarily used as a tool when he had to disguise his identity.

refinements.1: CRIT DMG increased by <r>20%</r>. Increasing the value of a Bond of Life increases the DMG the equipping character deals by <r>16%</r> for 6s. Max 3 stacks.
refinements.2: CRIT DMG increased by <r>25%</r>. Increasing the value of a Bond of Life increases the DMG the equipping character deals by <r>20%</r> for 6s. Max 3 stacks.
refinements.3: CRIT DMG increased by <r>30%</r>. Increasing the value of a Bond of Life increases the DMG the equipping character deals by <r>24%</r> for 6s. Max 3 stacks.
refinements.4: CRIT DMG increased by <r>35%</r>. Increasing the value of a Bond of Life increases the DMG the equipping character deals by <r>28%</r> for 6s. Max 3 stacks.
refinements.5: CRIT DMG increased by <r>40%</r>. Increasing the value of a Bond of Life increases the DMG the equipping character deals by <r>32%</r> for 6s. Max 3 stacks.

fr.flavor: Une rapière autrefois brandie par un menteur qui avait tout abandonné. Dans le passé, elle était principalement utilisée lorsqu'il devait dissimuler son identité.

refinements.1: Augmente les DGT CRIT de <r>20 %</r>. Lorsque la valeur d'un engagement vital augmente, les DGT infligés par le personnage équipé de l'arme augmentent de <r>16 %</r> pendant 6 s, cet effet pouvant être cumulé 3 fois maximum.
